name: Robert Cekada
current_role: Director of the Bureau of Alcohol, Tobacco, Firearms and Explosives (since April 2026)
summary: Robert Cekada, an ATF agent since 2005 who had been running its day-to-day operations as deputy director, was confirmed 59–39 on April 29, 2026, the first ATF director confirmed under a Republican president. He then joined Todd Blanche to announce nearly three dozen final and proposed firearms rules.
